name: @sos-2/tests-product-dogfood
description: SOS 2.0 Product Dogfood (Work Order P15, Lane A — product journeys): the full product-journey suite that drives SOS as a REAL PRODUCT through its public composed surfaces — first-time greenfield mission, brownfield repository onboarding, candidate/assurance/experiment/ASK, promotion, rollback, package composition, history, self-evolution, and the optional local-companion/IDE/browser path. Every journey runs behind deterministic reference adapters/bodies/executors (no real GitHub APIs, no real providers, no real deployment targets, no network, no ambient time/random); every journey asserts the P15 acceptance shape: the resulting repository, runtime, deployment and evidence graph are linked to exact revisions and ALL unresolved uncertainty is visible (never fabricated completion). Promotion + rollback assert revision-level state transitions with evidence per action via the merged action/state surfaces (never by mutating state directly). Package composition + self-evolution assert the ecology surfaces update as DATA (learned records), never by writing package internals. History asserts the full timeline is queryable end-to-end (decision -> action -> evidence -> state), including after rollback. The local-companion journey asserts the same flagship flow is reachable through the P11 surfaces. Plus the pinned discipline: zero new external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only), offline determinism, fixed vitest seed 424242, lockfile byte-identical on the branch, honest statuses throughout.
